intent.title: Correct the authorized release verification gate
intent.summary: User explicitly selected: Fix the verifier, then publish. Authorized scripts/verify-release.py and tests/test_release_verification.py, engine-managed seal, and regression checks. README and advertised version remain unchanged.
success: HTML and Markdown candidate badges accept matching advertised versions and reject mismatches.
out_of_scope: No README redesign, version change, or unrelated product behavior change.

components: README HTML and Markdown badge projections
external_dependencies: Existing HMAC key and explicit two-file user approval

evidence.summary: uv run --no-sync python scripts/verify-release.py failed with one error: README.md version badge is missing or malformed. README line 14 contains a valid HTML img source_candidate-0.5.0 badge and Source candidate 0.5.0 alt text; validator accepts only Markdown image syntax.

seams.name: Verify candidate version independent of badge markup
seams.description: uv run --no-sync python scripts/verify-release.py failed with one error: README.md version badge is missing or malformed. README line 14 contains a valid HTML img source_candidate-0.5.0 badge and Source candidate 0.5.0 alt text; validator accepts only Markdown image syntax.
seams.responsibility: Accept truthful HTML or Markdown badges without weakening version mismatch detection.
produces: Corrected observable boundary behavior and regression evidence
seams.independent_proof: Three specified behavioral regression selectors must pass after the fix and discriminate the prior defect.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Bypass validation or broaden write scope to a whole source directory
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would hide the defect or evade the existing authorization boundary.

legs.proof: Declared observable regressions and independent Task-Spec acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify candidate version independent of badge markup
tasks.goal: Accept truthful HTML or Markdown badges without weakening version mismatch detection.
tasks.done_condition: The unchanged current README passes release verification; HTML and Markdown badges with stale URL or label versions fail.

behavior.given: The candidate version is 0.5.0 and README uses either an HTML img or Markdown image with source_candidate-0.5.0 URL and Source candidate 0.5.0 label
behavior.when: The release verifier checks versioned release evidence
behavior.then: Matching version evidence passes independently of the image markup syntax.

behavior.given: A candidate badge URL or label advertises a version different from the package version
behavior.then: Version inconsistency remains a verification failure.

anti_patterns.action: Treat a structurally valid record or model assertion as authorization or measured success
anti_patterns.reason: Brief-Spec explains observations; Task-Spec and humans retain authorization and acceptance authority.
anti_patterns.instead: Preserve explicit basis and require source-bound receipts for stronger claims.

anti_patterns.action: Overwrite unrelated user changes or widen the signed write surface
anti_patterns.reason: Task-Spec authorization is bounded and receipt ownership must preserve user work.
anti_patterns.instead: Keep edits inside declared paths, serialize shared mutations and fail closed on conflicts.

anti_patterns.action: Satisfy an acceptance gate with stubs, source-text assertions, fabricated participants or stale summaries
anti_patterns.reason: Existence and apparent formatting do not prove the observable behavior.
anti_patterns.instead: Run the specified behavioral scenario on exact candidate inputs and retain truthful failure or blocked evidence.

do_not_touch: global host installations and user branch history
tasks.observability: Use the current valid HTML badge as the failing reproduction. Add semantic behavior regressions for HTML, Markdown, and stale URL/label versions. Do not edit README or disable version checks. Preserve all unrelated release checks. Run actual scripts/verify-release.py after the correction.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the authorized source/test patch; preserve all other user files and generated authorization records.
